checkpoint_selection: Final update only; no best-validation or best-test selection
training_loss: Mean six-prefix class cross-entropy, same actual recording labels and shared accepted information for every family
source_clock: max accepted modality source endpoint; zero increment for late observations at earlier endpoints
input: 55-dimensional accepted-cache/new-window row; no frozen old-head probabilities, object IDs or labels
shared_readout_information: All families receive the full padded six-slot accepted public history; persistent families additionally receive their actual content state
hx_financial_law: Fixed original HX defaults; literal Eq12 boundary and A7/Eq8/F/G maps. Only asset encoder, persistent content and readout learn.
hx_neural_mapping: Eight bounded absolute-asset cells. Source-tick observed crossings execute explicit reset and 0.5-second source-clock refractory rule, which is newly defined and not an HX-paper reset law.
trained_execution_ablations: hx_full and hx_margin trained separately from identical initialization. Evaluate both under full and margin execution for a complete training-by-execution comparison.
ordinary_gate: Same parameterization and initialization as HX arms, replacing financial bank by fixed ordinary nonlinear features. No FinancialMap.forward bank evaluation; shared financial boundary/drift/anchor construction remains and is charged.
normalization: Training-only mean/std of cached and fresh continuous feature columns 0:32 and 35:51; dt, levels, modality and validity flags remain exact
minibatch_stream: Per seed torch.Generator(seed+100000), 128 successive randint batches of 64; full stream SHA frozen and identical across families of each task/seed
evaluation_roles: Validation and historical-test are both previously exposed development replay. Evaluate only after source and checkpoint publication; never call them new independent confirmation.
diagnostics: all-prefix and final-prefix accuracy and NLL
actual reset and refractory restoration counts
per-fit complete worker CPU and parameter count
limitations: Fixed financial law is not all-HX-parameter or task-free-boundary learning
Source-tick reset is not continuous within-interval first-passage or repeated continuous resets
Equal update count is not matched CPU
Weak historical AV packets do not qualify the missing original strong frontends
New-head dynamic policy/value comparison requires separately trained calibration and execution adapters
